messages.subject: StanCon 2018 Invited Speaker Nominations
parts:
Know anyone who is doing something awesome with Stan? Let us know! To make sure that we don't miss out on any great speakers, the StanCon 2018 organizing committee is looking for nominations for invited/plenary speakers.

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfWkW8A9zoesosEc-YYUFU2-G_qJ4d7njP5w3WLdi1I-UNQhA/viewform
